chapter_title: The Interpretation of Happiness, Wisdom and Power;
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

** ¶5:**

The b lessedness of the Divine is the Lord Himself, the Divine Being of all truth, who dwells within the infinite expanse of wisdom. His Divine Wisdom is the Holy Proceeding — the living infl ux that flows through every successive state of spiritual life eman ating from Him, so that all those states are sustained and carried within it. His omn ipotence is the whole of the heav enly qualities, the abundances of good , and the ang elic ministries that proceed forth from Him — which are the successive states of life from the Divine.

**¶6:**

The containing form of celest ial love — in which Divine Love appears as it desc ends through medi ating degrees into the lower heav ens — bears within itself b lessedness, wisdom, and power. Its b lessedness is the Divine Proceeding that vivifies all things. Its wisdom is the recept ive form of truth from which spiritual life is conceived and born. And its power is all the heav enly aff ections, the abundances of good, and the ang elic ministries that are held within this doctrine of love.

** ¶7:** Again , blessedness, wisdom, and power d well within the containing form of divine truth. The b lessedness ther ein is the in most thought of Divine Love. The wisdom is the pure and innocent affection of truth , untouched by any falsity. And the power within this containing form is all the heav enly qualities, the abundances of good , and the angelic ministries that are established within the doctrine of truth.

**¶8:** Again , these three — blessedness, wisdom, and power — are present within the fundamental constituents of spiritual life itself . The b lessedness is the sustaining structure of divine wisdom in the Divine Human form — that is , the Lord as He appears to the heav ens as a one whole person . The wisdom is the derivative truths that proceed from the Divine Proceeding in ordered series. And the power is the derivative affections of good from the primord ial Divine Love — which are inter iorly present and interwoven throughout all of creation, even where they are hidden and bound within the natural degree , while the Divine Human sust ains the whole from in most to outmost.

---

* Note on structure : * The text traces a single thre efold reality — blessedness ( the good of love ), wisdom (the truth of that love), and power (the active proce eding of both into forms ) — as it desc ends through four degrees: the infinite Divine itself ( ¶5), the celest ial containing form of love (¶6), the spiritual containing form of truth (¶7), and the natural degree where these are enclosed within the very elements of created existence (¶8). This corresponds precisely to the Swed enborgian descent through celest ial, spiritual, and natural degrees, with the Divine Human as the sust aining form throughout .
